Context: 13. Encashment of Leave

- On compulsory retirement as a measure of penalty.
11. Industrial employees covered by CCS (Leave) Rules, 1972 are entitled to encashment of Earned Leave and Half Pay Leave, subject to overall limit with effect from 7-11-2006. GID (5-A), Rule 39-D.
12. Persons re-employed after retirement may be granted leave encashment up to a maximum of 300 days including the period from which encashment was allowed at the time of retirement.
